faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to help you get started right away
faq.q1: How do I enroll in a course?
faq.a1: Browse to your desired course, click 'Enroll Now', complete the checkout, and the course will instantly unlock in your dashboard.
faq.q2: Can I launch a course as an instructor?
faq.a2: Yes! Register as a teacher, set up your profile, and start building and publishing your courses right from your teacher dashboard.
faq.q3: How do coaching centers manage multiple teachers?
faq.a3: In your coaching profile, add your faculty to the 'Teachers Roster' and assign specific instructors to respective subjects when designing your course.
faq.q4: How do daily exams and certificates work?
faq.a4: Participate in exams linked to each lesson to earn scores and leaderboard ranks. Complete all curriculum milestones to automatically receive your verified certificate.
